source.author: lucr
source.text: Nam si de nihilo fierent, ex omnibus rebus omne genus nasci posset, nil semine egeret.
source.text_original: Nam si de nihilo fierent, ex omnibus rebus / omne genus nasci posset, nil semine egeret.
source.text_english: For if things were made from nothing, every kind could be born from all things; nothing would need a seed.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: sic enim dixit: nam si de nihilo fierent, ex omnibus rebus omne genus nasci posset, nil semine egeret.
reuse.text_original: sic enim dixit: nam si de nihilo fierent, ex omnibus rebus omne genus nasci posset, nil semine egeret.
reuse.text_english: For he said thus: for if things were made from nothing, every kind of thing could be born from all things; nothing would need seed.
